protocol.q1: Backgrade resolved pools (debuted + bust, postdebut-anchor rows excluded). Outcome basis: first-6-seasons bWAR window rebuilt from debuts.json per-season WAR (bust = 0); slices vary the window/era handling. Estimator A fits E[WAR|display grade] = exp(a + b*(g-45)) per pool via bin-weighted log-linear LS and reports the offset d with provisional(g) ~ graded(g-d). Estimator B grid-searches the display penalty delta maximizing cross-pool pair concordance of adjusted-grade order vs realized-WAR order (the board penalty's actual job), restricted to the operative band grade <= 50 where live provisional players exist. Bootstrap: row resampling within pool, seed 20260723.
protocol.q2: Forward-chained no-FV refit on the labeled matrix (train decision-year < Y, score Y, 2020-2024) using efv_ungraded's own fit/clip/grade functions; cap-bind = uncapped linear grade above the KNEE. Outcomes: consensus FV at cutoff (the real grade) + the censoring-adjusted 6yr WAR target. Live read: 2026-06-23 vintage joined to since-graded/debuted players.

penalty: At equal display grade, provisional (consensus-only, prior-anchored) rows forecast materially less realized WAR than production-informed eFV rows through the operative band: curve-match d_mean 6.5 (CI95 [4.3, 8.9]) on the all-rows slice, 5.8 (CI95 [3.3, 8.6]) on the fully-resolved slice; d at grade 42.5 runs 4.3-7.4 across every bust-inclusive slice.

Rank-optimal display penalty (the constant's actual job): all-rows operative band argmax 3.75, plateau [2.75, 4.5], and concordance at the shipped 4 equals the best value to 4 decimals; fully-resolved slice prefers more (8.0, boot CI95 [2.5, 8.2]). The shipped 4 sits inside every bootstrap CI; no slice supports LOWERING it.

The entire deficit is bust composition: debuted-only same-era rows show d ~5.5-7.4 mid-band (era-overlap slice) but the all-era debuted-only slice flips to ~-1 because recent graded debuts are WAR-window censored. The handicap is real but its size is era-entangled.

d(g) declines with grade (provisional slope is steeper): d ~1.7-2.7 by grade 50, negative by 55. A FLAT penalty over-penalizes the top of the band, but live provisional grades cap at ~48 and mass sits 20-38, so flat-4 is fine in practice.
ungraded_caps: HIT: of 236 forward-chained cap-bind hitters (uncapped grade > KNEE 43), 45.3% later carried a real consensus grade above CEIL 49 and mean realized 6yr WAR was 4.5 - but that share is carried ENTIRELY by elite-consensus players the live ungraded model never sees. The honest analog (cap-bind with consensus <= 45) realized mean 0.92 WAR (grade-implied ~30) and 0% earned a real grade above 49. CEIL 49 is already generous for the live population; raising it has no empirical support.

PIT: cap-bind arms' fringe analog (consensus <= 40) realized mean 0.53 WAR (grade-implied ~27), 8.4% at the CEIL-38-implied WAR level. The 81% share-above-ceil is MECHANICALLY inflated (sources grade listed arms 40+ by quantization, above CEIL 38 by construction) and must not be read as the cap being too low. KNEE 34 / CEIL 38 already sits at-or-above what the proxy outcomes imply.

Ordering above the knee carries real signal on both sides (Spearman uncapped-grade vs realized within cap-bind: hit 0.251, pit 0.218), which validates the SOFT order-preserving ceiling design over a hard cap.
Live resolution (one month, 06-23 vintage): 9 resolutions, 9/9 resolved at or above their provisional grade, none cap-bound. Too small to move a constant; re-run after the next grading cycles.

proposals.rationale: Empirical rank-optimal penalty 3.75 (plateau 2.75-4.5) on the all-rows slice with concordance at 4 indistinguishable from best; curve-match mid-band handicap 4.3-7.4; every CI contains 4. The fully-resolved slice would support raising toward 6-8, but the pool-mapping caveat (measured on consensus-only rows, applied to production-only ungraded rows) plus 9/9 live resolutions landing at-or-above the provisional grade argue against acting on that today. If ever revised, the direction is UP (5-6), never down.

The only cohort that would justify raising CEIL (cap-bind rows that beat 49) is elite-consensus players invisible to the live model; the fringe-consensus analog realized like FV ~30 with 0% above 49. Lowering is not supported either: above-knee ordering signal is real (Spearman 0.251) and the soft ceiling preserves it; the 06-23-vintage live joins resolved at-or-above grade.

Fringe cap-bind arms realized mean 0.53 WAR (grade-implied ~27); the nominal 81% above-ceil share is a grading-floor quantization artifact, not evidence. The 2026-07 de-rate (38->34 knee) already moved this constant in the direction the outcomes support; going lower would compress a band that still orders outcomes (Spearman 0.218).

caveats: POOL MAPPING (the big one): the measurable resolved pool defines provisional as consensus-anchored with NO production features (backgrade xfv_provisional, prior disabled so grade = consensus-implied); the live board's penalized players are the REVERSE deficit (production-only, no consensus, from xfv_ungraded). The estimated d transfers only under the assumption that a one-legged grade degrades similarly whichever leg is missing. No resolved cohort of true production-only grades exists yet; the live join is 1 month old.

ERA CONFOUND: provisional debuted rows are mostly 2011-2016 debuts, graded rows 2019-2026 (the flag is largely a MiLB-feature-coverage artifact); bust rows carry no date at all, so bust-era mix is uncontrolled. The era-overlap slice controls debut era for debuted rows only.

EXPOSURE CENSORING: 6yr WAR windows are complete only for debuts <= 2021. The all-rows slice deflates recent (mostly graded) debuts, biasing d DOWNWARD; the debuted-only all-era slice flips sign for exactly this reason. The resolved slice removes it at the cost of an older era mix.
BUST SELECTION: kind=bust means dropped from tracking; a recent 'bust' can still debut later but is scored 0 here (both pools).

Q2 PROXY SELECTION: matrix rows are all GRADED players - a favorably-selected stand-in for scout-passed-over live ungraded players. Even the fringe-consensus subsets were listed by at least one source. True live-population outcomes are likely WORSE than every proxy number here.

PIT ABOVE-CEIL SHARE: sources grade listed pitchers at 40+ (quantized), which exceeds CEIL 38 by construction; share_real_grade_above_ceil is mechanically ~1 for any listed arm and is reported for completeness only.
Outcome basis is bWAR (site-wide owner rule); target_censored on the matrix side includes the censoring-adjusted tail for open windows.

q1_penalty.pool_note: P = xfv_provisional backgrade rows (prior-anchored: consensus-only, no MiLB features at the anchor snapshot; efv_provisional_prior.enabled is false so the grade is pure consensus-implied). G = production-informed eFV rows. kind in {debuted, bust}; xfv_postdebut_anchor excluded; bust outcome = 0 WAR.

live_resolution.note: one month of live resolution only; the 06-23 vintage used HARD caps 43/40 (pre-soft-ceiling), so cap-bind live resolution is not yet observable - re-run this join after the next grading cycles
